title: PIL - Flotation Train 1 and 2 Conditioning Power Alarms

fields.latestPosition: Email sent 30/07 requesting put on hold for further review
fields.statusConflict: Form priority 2 – Within 1 Week vs register 3 – Next Fortnight
fields.why: Recently the conditioning power on train 1 and train 2 dropped to levels that impact flotation performance. There currently aren’t any alarms present on these values to indicate operating below setpoint.
fields.design:
Add alarms for the following calculation for PV (average over 30 mins time) is 7.5% below SP:
Train 1:
- 235-AG-502-PWR-M3
- 235-AG-002-PWR-M3
- 235-AG-003-PWR-M3
Train 2
- 235-PY-3637
- 235-PY-3638
- 235-PY-3639

Train 1 will also need faceplates created as currently doesn’t appear to any, Train 2 has them.
No trip to be implemented
Also change the naming of power trend for 235-TK-004 as its incorrect, it has 235-AG-002-PWR-M3 instead of 235-AG-003-PWR-M3
fields.impact: CROs will receive low conditioning power alarms on both trains and have new Train 1 faceplates.
